mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO job_favorite (profile_id, position_id, created_at) VALUES (#{profileId}, #{positionId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM job_favorite WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND position_id = #{positionId}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM job_favorite WHERE profile_id = #{profileId} AND position_id = #{positionId}
SELECT position_id FROM job_favorite WHERE profile_id=#{profileId} AND position_id IN #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_favorite WHERE profile_id = #{profileId}

SELECT p.id AS jobId, p.position_name AS positionName, p.position_code AS positionCode, p.department_name AS departmentName, p.organization_name AS organizationName, p.province AS province, p.city AS city, p.district AS district, TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(p.province, ''), ' ', COALESCE(p.city, ''), ' ', COALESCE(p.district, ''))) AS region, p.recruit_count AS recruitCount, p.education_requirement AS educationRequirement, p.major_requirement AS majorRequirement, m.match_result AS matchResult, m.reference_date AS referenceDate, 1 AS favorite FROM job_favorite f JOIN job_position p ON p.id = f.position_id LEFT JOIN job_match m ON m.profile_id = f.profile_id AND m.job_position_id = f.position_id WHERE f.profile_id = #{profileId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
